interpretation: This is not the OFR4 schema. It records semantic roles that OFR3 cases show must remain recoverable under compression, plus detail that may stay behind exact references.

roles.why: Without the exact invariant plus owner/scope, a local product/resource law is easily mistaken for a universal rule.
counterexamples: OFR3-GAME-01 would become a universal Preview/Commit UI doctrine.
OFR3-WEB-01 would become an above-the-fold law.

roles.why: A rejected model without its strongest rationale becomes a strawman; future Agents cannot recognize when changed conditions make it competitive again.
counterexamples: Runtime sealed memfd is genuinely stronger on byte immutability.
World family model C was strengthened and not falsified; it was unearned, not “wrong”.

roles.why: Without the observation that changed the decision, an invariant is dogma rather than causal knowledge.
counterexamples: Human Promotion Gate only earns necessity because removing it over-promotes AE-K15.
Web spacing treatment looked reasonable until rendered task evidence rejected it.

roles.why: Theory must explain what engineering/product decision survives; otherwise it cannot guide deletion, ownership or implementation changes.
counterexamples: Workstation needs exact same-path revalidation rather than generic network liveness.
Harness needs explicit selection instead of a Memory subsystem.

roles.why: Predicting what fails if the rejected model returns tests whether the reconstruction actually carries causal leverage rather than historical trivia.
counterexamples: Host generic Effect restoration predicts duplicated recovery authority.
Finance current-row restoration predicts PIT leakage and identity collision.

roles.why: A valid local falsifier can be overextended into a false prohibition. The boundary preserves option value and blocks universalization.
counterexamples: Runtime does not ban memfd for workloads that admit changed pathname semantics.
Security prospective revocation does not grant future permission after revoke.

roles.why: Rejected models are conditional negative knowledge, not constitutional taboos. Reopen conditions turn failure history into a living search boundary.
counterexamples: Game explicitly treats removed regions as burden-of-proof records, not bans.
Host generic lifecycle can return if multiple real consumers reproduce the same unowned responsibility.

roles.why: OFR0 reproduced that current Git, historical commits, deployed state and semantic checkpoints may be distinct valid time slices. Exact references make the reconstruction auditable and prevent retrospective rewriting.
counterexamples: Host OFR3 requires deleted commit 06ef7a3 to recover the full rival.
OFR3 cases are bound to the OFR0 frozen owner heads even if owners later advance.

roles.why: Exact field/class/code names are useful evidence refs but should not be mandatory semantic payload when the invariant can survive implementation change.
counterexamples: Host does not need every deleted EffectLifecycleHost method in a future compact Theory Unit.
World does not need one universal field list merely because R7 enumerated many native claim types.

roles.why: Reproducibility lineage must remain retrievable, but keeping runners/fixtures active is not required for default causal reconstruction.
counterexamples: PAL/Computing already deletes closed apparatus after evidence freezes.
Harness P4 deletes one-off discovery runners while preserving evidence.
